description: Run six DNA sequence-analysis tasks over the hosted Genomic Intelligence API: promoter region prediction, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression, and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Give it a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a FASTA; it resolves the sequence from Ensembl and returns structured predictions. No local GPU, model weights, or API key required. For research use, not clinical or diagnostic decisions.
